LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Shady Part of Me sends you on an emotional and dream-like journey, with breathtaking artistic direction and the enthralling voice of Hannah Murray (Game of Thrones, Skins).

As a little girl and her shadow, overcome emotional struggles through surreal dreamscapes across a touching narrative filled with twists and surprises. Both must learn, cooperate and evolve to progress in a poetic journey. 

•	Play with light and shadows, switching between 2D and 3D gameplay at will
•	Your ability to rewind time will help you get you through all situations
•	Explore surreal environments envisioned in a unique watercolor style
•	Solve contemplative puzzles to break the dream
•	Experience an introspective narrative journey like no other
